task_completion.description: Log in to SuiteCRM using the provided admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the SuiteCRM dashboard or home screen after the login page.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the Accounts module and filter for records assigned to 'Alex Mercer'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Accounts list view showing a filter applied for 'Assigned to: Alex Mercer' or a list of accounts where Alex Mercer is the assigned user.

task_completion.description: Mass update or individually reassign all of Alex Mercer's Accounts to 'Jordan Hayes'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A confirmation message of a successful update, or the Accounts list view now showing 'Jordan Hayes' as the assigned user for the previously identified accounts.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the Opportunities module and filter for records assigned to 'Alex Mercer'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Opportunities list view showing a filter applied for 'Assigned to: Alex Mercer' or a list of opportunities where Alex Mercer is the assigned user.

task_completion.description: Mass update or individually reassign all of Alex Mercer's Opportunities to 'Jordan Hayes'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A confirmation message of a successful update, or the Opportunities list view now showing 'Jordan Hayes' as the assigned user for the previously identified opportunities.

task_completion.description: Ensure records assigned to 'Taylor Reed' remain unchanged.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent should ideally check or the VLM should observe that Taylor Reed's records were not selected during mass updates or remain assigned to Taylor Reed in the list view.

integrity.description: The agent performed the task through the SuiteCRM web interface rather than using terminal/SQL commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show mouse movements, clicks on CRM buttons, and form fills in the browser, not just command line execution.

integrity.description: The agent searched for the records rather than navigating directly to specific record IDs if they weren't provided.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen using the search/filter functionality in the Accounts and Opportunities modules.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the live application and did not just display static images or mock data.
integrity.visual_evidence: The URL bar should show the local SuiteCRM instance, and UI elements (menus, loading spinners) should respond to agent actions.
